fato_historico: 1928: SS Vestris sinks approximately 200 miles (320 km) off Hampton Roads, Virginia, killing at least 110 passengers, mostly women and children who die after the vessel is abandoned.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to find your anchor today. Much like the quiet resilience needed when navigating unpredictable tides, you may feel called to support those around you with extra grace. It is a good time to shore up your emotional boundaries and consider how your steadfast nature provides safety for others during life's unexpected transitions.
frase_do_dia: Strength is found in the calm heart navigating through the stormiest seas.
significado_numero: A powerful number representing intuition and spiritual awakening on your path.
conselho: Prioritize your peace and extend kindness to those seeking comfort in your light.
